inputs.text: In southern Alberta, ordinary folks are rising up to protect their water from the destructive grip of coal mining and the big energy corporations that have long exploited our resources for profit. The Water Not Coal campaign, launched by Corb Lund last month, is gathering signatures for a citizen initiative petition that would force the Government of Alberta to prohibit through legislation all coal exploration. This grassroots effort directly challenges the entrenched industry interests and power structures that have always put corporate gains ahead of community health and the well-being of vulnerable populations, pushing instead for real institutional reform to defend public resources and stop ongoing harm to those most affected by inequality and environmental exploitation.
